_comment: Minted by the Julia reference binding's `run_inline_tests` (Tsit5, reltol=1e-12, abstol=1e-14) over ../../valid/faq/min_reduction_static_shaped_document.esm — the issue #432 fixture, referenced in place in `tests/valid/` rather than copied into this category. The document declares no differential equations and its observeds are shaped, so no integrator runs: every actual is one evaluation of the observed graph at that assertion's own `time` (esm-spec 6.6.3), point-sampled per its `coords` where it has any (6.6.5). All seven are small exact doubles, and all seven are FINITE by construction — an `inf` for `kstar` or a NaN for `n_above` is the reduction's identity element or a NaN term leaking out, not a computed number.
